changes: Authored continuous warm dawn and golden hour, bright cream daylight, violet dusk and blue moonlight with restrained local night lamps.
Reduced broad facade wash, strengthened sunlit botanical highlights and selective HDR bloom.
Moved the exploration camera closer, framed the party lower, and moved the desktop tutorial card aside so it does not cover the party.

brenCasting.direction: A young adult male adventure-game hero, twenty two years old. Clear warm light baritone in a youthful mid register, relaxed soft English accent. Spontaneous intimate conversation, quick wit, stubborn courage and vulnerable sincerity. Clean bright consonants, natural breaths, varied human rhythm and understated emotion. A believable friend talking nearby. No gravel, rasp, booming bass, announcer cadence, theatrical growling or over-enunciation. Excellent dry studio recording.

releaseNotes.title: Warmer light, steadier frames, a journey in your hand
items: Rebalanced the continuous solar cycle with amber dawn and golden hour, clear midday, readable blue moonlight, glowing windows and warm light reaching nearby surfaces across the scene.
Added depth-aware lens focus that keeps the party and playable middle ground sharp, with a consistent blur radius across display densities.
Extended meadow coverage to 185 metres in locations and 230 metres on the overworld, with lower-detail distant foliage and conservative spatial visibility.
Coalesced window and orientation changes, removed resolution-dependent shadow-map thrashing and kept shadow, reflection and scene buffers within stable budgets.
Added CPU/GPU-aware detail tiers and render scaling with slow recovery, refresh-divisor pacing and fixed light slots to avoid compiling a new lighting variant during attacks.
Character textures now upload only the current native frame on an individual canvas, preserving the authored pixels, frame borders, facing and separate character sizes.
Enlarged foliage batches, cached bounded live road queries and tightened scene resource cleanup for repeated travel and extended play.

Rebuilt compact portrait and landscape layouts with journey shortcuts, expandable objectives, compact party cards, a touch joystick, sprint toggle and interaction button. Touch cancellation clears held movement.

Added larger separated touch targets for enemy selection and kept the full battle in frame in portrait mode. Strengthened pooled attack lights and highlight bloom so abilities illuminate the actual environment.

releaseNotes.title: Clearer routes, steady characters and flowing water
items: Removed the mismatched front-facing Soren idle poses while preserving the complete native coat animation.
Kept physical bridge decks visible through scene trimming and cutaways, and extended terrain beneath enlarged approaches.
Removed stray neighbouring road strips, continued roads past exit markers and rerouted the Network approach around its cliff.
Matched walking heights to the fine road surfaces and removed road-blocking rocks without a valid relocation.
Restricted the remnant rock overhang to its own location, reserved full road clearance and moved noticeboards to walkable shoulders with collision only while visible.
Slowed the sluice release and downstream recovery; water now clears the stone sill before the lower pools fill.
Removed the sweeping current ribbon and obsolete spray, with slower flowing surface and cascade textures.
Replaced overlapping old cloud planes with a bounded, rounded cloud volume linked to the moving sun, shadows and light shafts.
Cleaned up previous weather chunks during repeated setup and kept outdoor light, dust and cloud colours tied to the day/night cycle.

releaseNotes.title: A moving sky, a better-built world
items: The sun now crosses the sky from east to west. Fourteen smoothly blended colour keys tint direct light, sky, clouds, ambient fill, haze, shafts and dust: violet predawn, peach sunrise, blue midday, amber golden hour, rose dusk and cool moonlight.
Moving volumetric clouds share one world-space field with surface shadows, sunlight shafts and airborne dust. Clouds interrupt the light, while persistent rays stay anchored in the landscape.

Rebuilt settlement facades with recessed doors, fitted awnings, complete roof ends, framed windows, properly seated chimneys and clear entry steps. Removed overlapping inn additions and duplicate facade layers.
Forest homes now have closed curved roof ends and fitted porches. Relief pavilions have colliders around real posts, rear panels and furniture, allowing passage under the open canopy.
Rearranged shop and smithy shelving, weapon displays and service counters. Back doors remain clear, and the aid office now has its own desk, waiting area and storage.

Window light changes at dusk. Outdoor pollen, night fireflies, cool ambient fill and cloud-filtered sunbeams respond to the continuous clock and weather. Loading stills show the rebuilt in-game village and rooms.

releaseNotes.title: Living gardens, clearer light
items: Fixed trees failing to reveal the party: every foliage detail level now shares the same individual-tree cutaway mask, while real shadows and water reflections retain the complete tree.
Rebuilt the forest as branched 3D crowns of folded, transparent PixelLab leaf sprays. Oaks, birches, maples, willows, spruces and flowering trees vary in shape, height, colour and placement.
Added five flower forms, curved grass tufts, folded ferns and leafy shrubs, planted in stable roadside and garden clusters. Removed the black distant shrub geometry.

Integrated 17 native 512px PixelLab assets, including paving, mossy paving, slate, plaster and meadow textures with matching normal maps. Material scale makes individual stones and roof courses more readable.
Moved the sun to illuminate building fronts, balanced warm sunlight against cool fill, reduced pale haze and broad additive rays, and preserved fine detail through gentler focus and bloom.
Adjusted the exploration lens for a closer diorama view with a slight diagonal angle. Forest batching uses larger cells and shared detail levels; loading stills now show the current in-game artwork.

Optimized live water reflections with a cropped reflected view that draws only scenery sampled by visible water, preserving the full projective image and immediate updates. Inactive botanical detail levels are released during travel.

releaseNotes.title: A warmer welcome indoors
items: Rebuilt all seven active interiors with a closer, front-facing camera pitched down 25 degrees, including responsive tracking on narrow screens.

Added four native PixelLab interior assets: chestnut wall panels, detailed hearth stone, a woven rug and framed riverland artwork. Stocked shelves, table settings, chairs, banners and plants bring the rooms to life.
Added an open, animated fireplace and warm pooled lighting that affects characters and furnishings. Counter heights keep hosts readable, with clear routes to services, exits and inn save seals.
Fixed the missing objective for A choice of restraint. Tavin now has a visible encounter seal and affected villagers at the gathering ground; the marker clears after victory.
Replaced the old loading still with four fresh 1080p captures of the actual village, inn, shop and archives. Loading artwork now follows the destination, with no interface baked into the images.

releaseNotes.title: Sharper surfaces, smoother travel
items: Fixed scenery trimming detaching party sprites during fast travel. Destination arrival now restores the full party and checks the destination camera before showing the scene.
Removed uneven refresh-deadline frame skipping. Small screens use appropriately sized reflection and shadow buffers, with stable high-DPI resolution and idempotent resizing.
Replaced the Map icon with a clear PixelLab parchment map and kept an opaque navy-and-gold plate on hover and keyboard focus.
Added ten new native 512-pixel PixelLab world surfaces and nine matching normal maps, covering limestone, paving, plaster, slate, oak timber, meadow turf, soil, foliage and waterfall detail.
Restored physically based lighting for buildings and terrain, with material roughness, native normal detail, wet response and surface-attached crevice shading.
Added folded leaf fans to instanced tree crowns, planted flower clusters beside clear paths and doubled world-anchored floating dust particles.
Improved water depth colour, downstream ripples, broken reflections, textured cascade flow and subtle world-space spray.
Balanced warm directional light with cool sky fill and added restrained depth-selective diorama focus while keeping the playable middle ground sharp.

releaseNotes.title: Clearer battles and roads worth exploring
items: Kept the entire sluice gate, frame and stone supports together through scene batching, reflections and visibility updates. Bren now works from the correct side of the wheel. House cutaways now include main roofs in every settlement, without reacting to projecting ornaments.
Extended every POI approach and departure road with larger outskirts, more housing plots, smooth grades and glowing outward-facing exits.
Linked persistent long sunshafts and moving sky clouds to the same world-space shadow field; lantern changes fade smoothly.

Rebuilt Equipment and Inventory with illustrated character panels, live comparisons, item inspection, recipient selection, sorting and filters. Added high-resolution PixelLab portraits and distinct item artwork.
Added purchasable accessory and off-hand fittings with real MP/defense bonuses and working equip/unequip actions.
Moved monster health bars beneath their sprites, enlarged the target arrow and added a glowing red silhouette outline that preserves enemy colours.
Kept all round participants in the turn order and marked completed, current and defeated turns instead of removing entries.
Batched grass and flower patches into fewer colour and shadow submissions while retaining individual wind, interaction and cutaway masks.

releaseNotes.title: A continuous world, a clearer journey
items: Rebuilt the title around a live Brookstead river view with the supplied gold crystal wordmark, PixelLab navigation artwork, credits and a chronological release history.
Matched the loading screen to a sharp still from the same village camera, with actual loading progress and journey tips.
Rebuilt Journal, Inventory, Party, Equipment and Settings around the navy-and-gold references, with new PixelLab frames, scenery, compass and illustrated icons.
Added character recipient tabs, inventory filters, equipment comparisons, quest history, lore/help pages and grouped settings while preserving the live game data and controls.
Made distant scenery use the foreground terrain shader, multi-cluster trees, flowers and complete house meshes; removed overlapping terrain and continued the river past the village.
Rebuilt sluice supports and separated overlapping stone caps. Fitted complete railings along all four stair flights and landings.
Added varied ground-conforming rain puddles using river artwork, reflected sky, wet edges and ripples.
Anchored sunbeams in the world and linked their brightness to large moving cloud shadows.
Retained full-resolution rendering, spatial vegetation batches, responsive laptop/phone layouts, and three-slot save, load, overwrite and delete controls.
Fixed retained terrain LOD meshes and released instance buffers across repeated travel, preventing geometry counts from growing during extended play.

releaseNotes.title: Light, weather and a clearer view
items: Replaced the extra projected character silhouettes with animated alpha-tested shadows from the actual scene light.
Aligned outdoor exploration straight ahead, with a gentle downward view closer to the battle camera.
Added dimensional overhead cloud volumes and soft depth-tested shafts sharing the moving cloud-shadow field.
Made sluice visibility and moving gate transforms independent of static scene culling.
Rebuilt rain puddles as irregular ground-conforming surfaces with ripples, sky reflections and gradual drying.
Separated wet stone, timber, foliage and character shading, removing painted-looking highlights on trees.
Removed overlapping circular ground pads at community pavilions and the relief-station title view.
Scaled the HUD for laptops, tablets and short displays, with a compact phone layout and scrollable party cards.
Improved narrow-screen menu navigation, dialogue and title layouts.
Replaced the expandable feature catalogue with this dated, readable release history.

releaseNotes.title: Initial alpha release
items: Introduced the regional Elder Light story, five companions, six story battles and four Light restorations.
Built the playable overworld, fifteen points of interest and seven interiors, with a 3D discovery atlas and fast travel.
Added the gate and pump waterworks, village routines, interactions and fifteen optional local requests.
Implemented eight-direction running, Shift sprinting, trailing companions and object clearance.
Added side-on turn-based combat, timed attack chains, skills, items, guarding, Ascension and results/growth screens.
Integrated the approved PixelLab cast, 4,878 native poses, portraits, surface textures and loading illustrations.
Added 259 ElevenLabs voice performances and 93 music, ambience and effects recordings.
Implemented inventory, equipment, shops, inn recovery and three journey slots at inns and location entrances.
Added text-only guided field lessons and the scripted opening combat tutorial.
Introduced changing time of day, weather, moving cloud shade, flowing rivers, reflections and reactive foliage.
Rebuilt the title screen with cycling live locations, save previews, deletion and overwrite confirmations.
Expanded POI approaches and exits, introduced the gold PixelLab HUD, corrected roofs and repeated building cutaways, and optimized resident navigation, reflections and sustained native rendering.
